leaves.doc: raynaud-proof, printed form (specialization): Raynaud's criterion, SGA 7 I Exp. IX Prop. 4.7 (number UNVERIFIED), over a strictly henselian DVR O of a field K of characteristic 0 with perfect, hence algebraically closed, residue field: if m >= 3 is invertible in O and the points of order m are rational over K, every Neron model of A over O is semistable. A specialization of raynaudSemistableSH (RaynaudCP.raynaudSemistableSHcp_of_SH); the live proof uses 4.7 only in this generality (RaynaudCP.consumers_of_cp). With kappa(O) algebraically closed the k(s) and geometric readings of 'semistable' agree.
